summary: Outside-consultant UX audit of PRODUCTION https://dalleoopen.com (read-only, no logins, no mutations) 24h before tournament day. Audited home / leaderboard / champions / teams / schedule / gallery / draft / committee / brandon / rules / announcements / score at 390px mobile and 1440px desktop. Countdown reads ~01d 02h to Saturday Sept 5 2026 (accurate). No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 390 or 1440. All 14 gallery images loaded; zero broken images sitewide. Verified pre-round leaderboard empty state + captain sign-in banner. HOWEVER: one CRITICAL production regression found — the 1A / 1B letter suffix that distinguishes the two Hole 1 teams has been dropped everywhere on production (homepage pairings strip shows '1 Martin / 1 White'; /schedule Hole 1 card shows the two teams under a single '1' with only 'Paired together' — no 1A/1B chips; /teams cards show BOTH Team Martin and Team White as 'Shotgun start · Hole 1 · 8:00 AM'; JS text search for '1A' or '1B' on /schedule returns zero matches). Iteration_10 verified this fix on preview — it is missing from production, meaning the fix never shipped or was overwritten. Everything else is polish-tier.

ui_bugs.component: PairingsStrip (home) + Schedule Hole 1 card + Teams cards for Martin/White
ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL production regression — 1A/1B letter suffix is missing everywhere. Homepage strip reads '1 Martin, 1 White, 13 Franklin...' with no A/B; /schedule Hole 1 card lists both teams under a single '1' with just 'Paired together'; /teams shows both Martin and White as 'Shotgun start · Hole 1 · 8:00 AM' (identical copy — captain cannot tell which is the 1A vs 1B tee). page-wide text search for '1A' or '1B' on /schedule returns zero occurrences. Iteration_10 verified this on preview; production is behind. Tournament-day risk: two Hole 1 teams cannot distinguish their starting tee from the site.

ui_bugs.component: Global Navigation (header, both desktop and mobile hamburger)
ui_bugs.issue: No primary nav entry for /score or /announcements. The 9-item nav is Leaderboard/Champions/Teams/Schedule/Gallery/Draft/Committee/Brandon/Rules. On tournament day the ONE audience actively transacting is captains — their entry point (/score) exists only in the footer and via the leaderboard sign-in banner. A cold captain opening the site at 7:55am on a phone in sunlight has to scroll to the footer to find 'Captain Scoring'. Same for /announcements (only reachable via the mid-page 'All Announcements' link inside Chapter 02, or by typing the URL). Recommend a persistent 'Score' pill (gold) in the top-right of the header on tournament day.

Links to bare 'https://www.instagram.com/' (Instagram homepage) — effectively a dead link. Either supply the real handle or remove the icon; a broken social link is a trust hit on an otherwise polished editorial site.

Displays 8 unlabeled names (Patrick Martin, Destin White, Jacob Foret, Randy Boner, Zach Doell, Nate Breaud, Trey Berner, Tre Franklin). A first-time visitor cannot tell these are the eight team captains — no 'Captains' sublabel or team-name association. Add a one-word label ('The Captains' or 'Team Captains') above the list.

Most recent dated post on /announcements and the homepage bulletin is 'AUGUST 6, 2026' — 29 days stale on the eve of the tournament. Content is not wrong, but the site's own bulletin has been silent for a month. A short 'Tournament Eve' post tonight would make the site feel live.

Copy 'Every legendary tournament needs people making questionable decisions behind the scenes...' plus titles like 'Chief Instigation Officer', 'Vice President of WOAHs', 'Vice President of Strategic Indifference' break the otherwise premium/museum tone the rest of the site achieves. On-brand for insiders, but reads as inside-joke to a first-time guest arriving via the memorial page. Consultant note only — leave if intentional.

ui_bugs.component: Home hero 'Play Me!' script under Dalleo Open
ui_bugs.issue: Subjective: playful script sits directly adjacent to 'IN MEMORY OF BRANDON DALLEO' banner. If this is Brandon's own catchphrase (likely), keep it — otherwise the tonal contrast is noticeable to an outside reader in the first 3 seconds. Consultant note.

'DAYS / HOURS / MINUTES / SECONDS' labels are set at a weight that visually competes with the gold 'Dalleo Open' wordmark above them at 1440px. Consider a lighter weight or letter-spaced small-caps. Subjective.

issues: STRENGTH — near-perfect sunlit-course UX: eight 147x48 team buttons with per-team color dots (data-testid=captain-team-*); large 302x52 primary CTA (data-testid=captain-login-submit) initially disabled; single-purpose PIN input with type=password and placeholder '4–8 digits' (data-testid=captain-pin-input); headline copy 'Choose your team and enter your captain PIN to score your round' is unambiguous. Contrast sweep of every visible <h1/h2/h3/p/label/button/a> at 390px returned ZERO elements below 4.5:1. Recommend no changes.

STRENGTH — memorial banner, 7th Annual mark, real countdown, script 'Play Me!', team photo, and estd/2020 mark all above the fold on both widths. Emotional purpose (memorial) and functional purpose (tournament Saturday) both readable in first 3 seconds. Design credibility is high.

STRENGTH — flag icon + 'Scoring has not started yet' empty state + 'Back to Home' CTA + gold 'Captains — sign in to get ready for Saturday's round' banner with 'Sign In' pill. Reads exactly right for tournament eve.
STRENGTH — 'THE TROPHY WALL · EST. 2020' small caps, oversized serif 'Champions', Chapter I · The Roll of Honor timeline with year vertebrae. Museum feel achieved.

STRENGTH — dignified portrait, heart icon, script 'In Memory of Brandon Dalleo' as h1, warm subhead, four-pillar values (Remember / Celebrate / Compete / Stay Connected). Tone appropriate; no edits recommended.
The 'Paired together' pill is present but the two teams (Martin, White) sit under a single '1' chip with NO 1A / 1B differentiation. See critical bug above — same root cause.
14/14 images loaded, zero broken. Note: NO images use loading='lazy' — all 14 ship in the first paint (see A8). Ok for the current photo count but will become a perf concern if it grows.

rca of the issue: 1A/1B REGRESSION RCA: iteration_10 shipped and verified the PairingsStrip + startingHoleLabel change on the preview environment on Sept 4. On production the label field appears to be either (a) not deployed, (b) overwritten by an admin edit that stripped the letter suffix, or (c) rendered from a code path that doesn't consume startingHoleLabel yet. Reproduction: open https://dalleoopen.com/ in an incognito window at 390px; the pairings strip below the marquee reads '1 Martin / 1 White / 13 Franklin / 14 Berner / 15 Breaud / 16 Doell / 17 Boner / 18 Foret'. Expected '1A Martin / 1B White / 13 Franklin ...'. Mitigation: (1) confirm prod bundle hash matches the iteration_9/10 preview build; (2) if bundle is current, inspect the /api/public/teams response on production for the startingHoleLabel field on the Martin and White records — if the field is empty/null in prod DB, the fix is code-only and the DB was never re-seeded on prod; (3) redeploy or run the admin update to set Martin='1A' and White='1B' and hard-refresh. Retest all three touchpoints (home strip, /schedule Hole 1 card, /teams cards).
